lessons: README.md line 99 adds the markdown link `[ClutchWork](customization://clutchwork)`. tests/unit/test_readme.py::test_links_are_absolute requires every `](target)` in README.md to start with `https://`, so this link fails the test.

Fix README.md only: write the refresh hint as inline code (`customization://clutchwork`) or plain text, not a markdown link. Keep the `## Antigravity plugin` section and the `uv run clutch host antigravity` setup line. The ticket requires the link form only in CLI output and host-contract.md.

Before committing, run `./dev.py test tests/unit/test_readme.py` together with the ticket's `## Verification` command. README.md is fenced, and test_readme.py checks it even though the ticket does not list that test.
